notes.title: Purgatory is going to be available for free!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, first of all a massive thank you to everyone who purchased this game and helped to support an independent developer! You rock!

Now, as sales have been pretty much non-existent for a while now, save for the odd one here and there, I've decided to make the game available for free. This game, moreover, this story, is one of my personal favourites, and I'd like as many people as possible to experience it. 

I'm hoping to develop more games in the future, but I don't know how realistic a goal that is. Gotta pay the bills, and developing indie games isn't a great way to do that these days.

Thanks again for your support.

notes.title: Latest Build is Stable!
notes.notes:
The latest build of the game is stable.
 
I really can't apologise enough; as a developer I've completely failed you. Hopefully those of you who've been unable to play the game will give it another chance now that we've fixed the issue, literally within hours of becoming aware of it, which is the best we could do under the circumstances.

notes.title: Technical Issues, massive apologies!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, I'm so sorry about the current state of the game. Looks like there was an error (most likely on our part) with the most recent update of the game, and we weren't aware of it until now. Rest assured that we're working to put an update out TODAY, or failing that, a roll-back, so that customers can actually enjoy the game.

Again, very very sorry; we'll do better.

notes.title: Just Released on Steam, Atonement 2: Ruptured by Despair
notes.notes:
The brand new Atonement 2: Ruptured by despair has just been released! For those of you who loved the first game, here comes the sequel, with even more great gameplay, story and characters! 

The last king was killed over 400 years ago and the global rule of the land ceased to exist. The Vindicator is coming. ~a decadent, dark fantasy world with a new take on the concepts of Angels and Demons! 
Click the link below if your interested then hurry, buy the game with a 30% launch discount and whittle hours completing it! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/533820/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

If you haven't tried the first game and this sounds like your cup of tea, go check it out on the following link!

notes.title: Coming Soon! Trading Cards, localisation!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Thanks for checking out Purgatory, our labour of love!

Just a quick note to tell you that we're planning on localising the game into additional languages over the coming weeks.

We'll also be adding cards too.

We've released the 'development' build of the game, though in truth, we feel that the game is complete. However, there may be a few bugs here and there, particularity on the weird and wonderful concoctions of hardware that are out there in internet-land. So don't be shy, drop on by the community hub if you have any problems!
